research_notes: REAL, sourced: CARE Ratings revised Orchid Pharma's long-term bank facilities to CARE D from CARE B- (short-term: CARE D from CARE A4) on 18 April 2017. NCLT Chennai separately admitted the company into CIRP on 17 August 2017 (Lakshmi Vilas Bank, operational creditor) - a ~4-month gap between this signal and the filing. Sources: Business Standard (business-standard.com/article/news-cm/orchid-pharma-rallies-7-21-in-two-sessions-117041900595_1.html and business-standard.com/article/companies/nclt-orders-initiating-insolvency-proceedings-against-orchid-pharma-117082300212_1.html); ICMAI 'Corporate Insolvency Process of Orchid Pharma' casebook (ipaicmai.in/IPANEW/UploadFiles/Other/Casebook_Orchid_Pharma.pdf). CIRP admission date and CIN independently corroborated via IBBI's public case record.

REAL: no adverse rating action found for Neuland Laboratories over the comparable window; the company remained a going concern and has since grown substantially. Matched to Orchid Pharma on size and sector (FY17 revenue ~Rs 579 Cr API/CDMO manufacturer vs. Orchid's ~Rs 683 Cr cephalosporin API manufacturer). Source: Screener.in financial history.
